in_marathi.name: Balakrishnan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu as a child
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balakrishnan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balakrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu, signifying the deity as a child. This name is derived from two words - 'Balaka' meaning child and 'Krishna' meaning Lord Vishnu.
